title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech-led melt-up, but breadth is rotting underneath.
Semis (SOXX +3.39%) and silver (+3.37%) led a large-cap risk-on tape as Treasury yields eased, yet XLK bled $563mm over five days and only 31% of S&P names sit above their 50-DMA. This is money chasing index beta, not conviction in the average stock.

INDICES — VIX 15.4, below its 20-day (15.7). SOXX +3.39%, QQQ +1.73%, SPY +1.13%, DIA +0.61%, IWM +0.53%. Large beat small by 1.20pp. Dollar -0.07% while TLT +1.11% and silver +3.37% — a weak-dollar, duration-bid day.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY 1.3x, QQQ 1.2x, DIA 1.3x, RSP 0.9x, GLD 0.6x: index volume up with price up = accumulation at the cap-weighted level, but SLV 0.8x on a +3.37% move is thin. Only 31% of S&P 500 above the 50-DMA, 50% above the 200-DMA, adv/dec 282/216, up/down volume 2.14, new 60d highs/lows 14/43. Participation diverges from the index move — apex-heavy, narrow.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +2.25%, XLY Discretionary +1.10%, XLU Utilities +0.90%, XLE Energy +0.70%, XLB Materials +0.69%, XLV Healthcare +0.62%, XLRE Real Estate +0.30%, XLP Staples +0.19%, XLI Industrials +0.18%, XLF Financials -0.09%, XLC Comms -0.58%. Top industries: SILJ +5.17%, DRAM +4.43%; bottom: ITA -0.65%, DBA -1.39%. Flows contradict price: XLF +813mm (90th pctile) while XLK bleeds -563mm (6th pctile). Money is entering financials and exiting the tech leader — that is short-covering in semis, not rotation. Call it AI hardware leading on price, contested on flows.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.70 (complacent), QQQ 1.35 (hedged); skew +4.5% to +5.5% across the board. SPY spot sits at the 765 GEX flip — dealer hedging will amplify either direction. VIXEQ 36.4 vs VIX 15.4 is a wide dispersion gap: single-stock rotation tape, not macro.

CROSS-ASSET — Silver +3.37% with SLV PCR 1.01 and skew -2.5% screams chase, not hedge, as the dollar slips. TLT +1.11% alongside gold +1.69% confirms a real-rates bid. Next FOMC Oct 28; Polymarket prices 50% no-change / 50% for a 25bp hike.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 49.4, neutral. Movers: INTC +7.67%, AMD +6.36%, WDAY +6.14%. JETS vol 2.8x with price +1.33% = accumulation; BA 2.1x with -2.46% = distribution. Worst 20d sector XLI -7.11%. Watch IWM (+0.53%, PCR 1.24, 20d -5.40%) for a Small-cap break, XLF (-0.09% but +813mm inflow) for rotation confirmation, and SPY at the 765 gamma flip.
